CO-ROUTINE m
  SCAN collection_fts VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 0:M1
  SEARCH c USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
  USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
SCAN m
SEARCH c USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_collection_1 (id=?)
CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 9
  SEARCH cw USING PRIMARY KEY (collection_id=?)
  SEARCH w USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
  CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 7
    SEARCH vr USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
  SEARCH vl EXISTS USING COVERING INDEX work_library_work (work_id=?)
  LIST SUBQUERY 6
    SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    CREATE BLOOM FILTER

  SEARCH cw USING PRIMARY KEY (collection_id=?)
  SEARCH w USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
  CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 2
    SEARCH vr USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)

  LIST SUBQUERY 1
